Hi Priya / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Attached is the first-pass action plan we sketched during the call (FinEx_MAP_draft_v1.pdf) — I pulled out milestones, owners, high-level dependencies, and a proposed target close. TL;DR: looks like a Q3 implementation target if procurement and security reviews move at typical FinEx pace.

Please review and confirm the following so we can move to a shared MAP in Google Docs:
- Economic buyer: who should be listed as the approver for budget?
- Security owner: point person for the SOC 2 / data flow review
- Legal owner: who will shepherd T&Cs and SOW redlines?
- Engineering lead: main contact for integration testing and sandbox access

Attached: FinEx_MAP_draft_v1.pdf, FinEx_SOW_requirements.xlsx
Shared doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1FinExMAP-draft
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/FINEX-2026-042

Key milestones (high level) in the draft:
1) Commercial approval (contract signature) — target: 2026-07-15 — owner: TBD (economic buyer)
2) Security & legal review complete — target: 2026-06-30 — owner: FinEx security/legal + Redwood compliance
3) Sandbox integration & POC — target: 2026-07-31 — owner: FinEx eng / Redwood SE
4) Production cutover & go-live — target: 2026-08-15 — owner: FinEx eng / Redwood delivery

Dependencies called out in the draft: sample data for throughput testing, SOC 2 evidence for data retention, SAML SSO configuration, and procurement PO/timeline.

Next steps I propose: you confirm owners on Monday, we update the Google Doc, and then Marcus/SE will schedule an integration planning session for the week of May 18.

Thanks — I’ll hold on making procurement/contract assumptions until we have owners mapped.

Thanks Priya — a few tech notes to surface for the MAP dependencies section: 

1) Data access: for throughput testing we need a representative 1–2GB sample (anonymized) or a synthetic dataset that matches your median request size. Owner: FinEx eng (Rajiv) — Redwood can provide a simple generator if needed.
2) Auth & SSO: we can support SAML or OIDC; timeline for SSO cert exchange typically 3 business days after contact setup. Owner: FinEx security / IT (Sofia).
3) Sandbox sizing: recommend reserving a dedicated dedicated instance for the POC (8x A100-equivalent) for 2 weeks to avoid noisy neighbor effects — cost estimate in the attached Excel.

I’ll add these explicitly as dependencies in the MAP doc and mark Redwood tasks (e.g., provide SOC 2 snippets, sandbox build steps) as internal-owned items.

Marcus Lin
